title: Consolidate density profiles and row-skeletons for table & control components
creator: Ava Martinez
description: We have drift across table rows, buttons, and control atoms where density, spacing, and interactive states live in inconsistent tokens and component variants. This ticket consolidates: 1) density token mapping (compact / default / comfortable) across button, table row, and chart legend atoms; 2) a single set of row-skeleton components with predictable auto-layout constraints; 3) naming rules for variant axes to enable stable publishes. Goal is to reduce publish failures, simplify developer handoff, and remove ambiguous instance overrides.
acceptance_criteria: A single density token set exists (density.compact, density.default, density.comfortable) and is referenced by buttons, tables, and legend components
Table row skeleton components expose only spacing tokens and a single horizontal auto-layout axis (no nested stacks), and resizing behavior passes QA in three breakpoints
Variant naming follows pattern component.variant:density and is documented in the publish checklist
Pre-publish CI check passes for 100% of library pages after migration (no orphan tokens or broken instances)
Design review approval recorded and a migration PR created for each dependent codebase
tasks: Inventory current tokens and component variants (scripted export + manual spot-check in Figma)
Author density token mappings and update token file in Figma Tokens plugin
Refactor table row components to single-axis auto-layout with pinned spacing tokens
Create migration script (Figma plugin snippet) to swap legacy instance variants to new naming
Run publish in staging file and execute pre-publish checklist; address failures
Coordinate with frontend (ENG) for runtime token names and update design-to-code doc
Ship library publish with rollout notes and rollback steps
design_notes: Prefer a single horizontal auto-layout for rows to preserve natural truncate behavior and simplify kernel of constraints
Avoid nested frames for spacing; use padding tokens and component internal gaps to reduce instance overrides
Button density should reference density tokens and not individual token aliases like btn-compact-spacing; keep aliasing minimal
Charts/legend items will adopt density tokens for row spacing but keep marker sizing independent (marker.size token) to avoid layout regressions
